column3: Manami Route ・ Just Like a Galge
But, you know, it'd be better if we just went straight home today...
Hellooooo? Manami-san～?
...You know, Kyou-chan...
Hm? What's up?
I... I don't want to go home today...
Like I said, stop saying things that can cause misunderstandings!
Ah! Ah-ahhh. T-That's not what I meant! I just, with Kyou-chan, well... umm....
Calm down, Manami. There's no hurry y'know.
Yeah... W-Well...
I want to... talk with you... a lot.
Talk...?
Yeah, about, you know, here and there, now and then...
I've... Always watched Kyou-chan...
The diligent, hard working Kyou-chan, the slumped, depressed Kyou-chan, I've seen all different sides of you.
But you know, once I think about it, I have only been observing.
That's not true. Just having you there with me, I feel safe and relaxed...
See? "Just there with me." I'm not doing anything...
It's diff-... that's not what I meant...
A-And then... Little by little, even if only just a little bit... I was thinking it'd be nice if I was able to change...
I'm well aware that I'll never be like Kirino-chan or Ayase-chan.
Also, I... I want to be able to support Kyou-chan, any way I can.
Manami... Is that how you feel about me?
It's like... Being told that face to face is...
She said "Only observing", but I was grateful for even just that. It's something I hold dear; for me, who was neglected as a kid, it was strangely
moving...
Thank you...
Ah...Mmm!
...Uhh. W-What is this...?
I can't keep this conversation going! Or rather, I just can't take much more!! Yeah... I hate to be mean to Manami but... For now...
S-so, are you done with what you wanted to say?
'Cause today you've been a bit strange so...we should get going-
N-NO!
G-Guess not...
I-I don't want to... go home... Okay?
I...umm... with Kyo-Kyou-chan...
